name: soft-door-box
task: Open the door, then, if possible, pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) hard captures 'Open the door', and the soft RespondedExistence(door_open, target_picked_up) captures the preference 'if possible, pick up the box'.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up, u2) -> 6
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up, u2) -> 11
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 11
